creature_families: Serpent family (SNA, 13 ids): snakes, drakes and dragon-class NPCs share one model
Floater and crawler family (SPI, 13 ids): spiders, floating eyes, blobs and a mimic share one model
Quadruped family (WOL, 9 ids): wolves, big cats and similar
Catch-all humanoid (HUM, 63 ids, default for any unmapped id; race_class.rs:207)
Other archetypes: FIS 6, FRG 5, ELF 4, RAT 4, WSP 3, IKS 2, DWF 2, WRM 1, VAH 1, BAT 1

top_creatures.label: Serpent Drake family
top_creatures.why: One model stands for snakes and dragon-class NPCs; reads cheaply at 375 wide
top_creatures.keep: One silhouette stands for several threats
top_creatures.change: Our own dragon silhouette; no model reuse

top_creatures.label: Floater family
top_creatures.why: Floating eyes, spiders, blobs and a mimic share one archetype
top_creatures.keep: One archetype for floating and crawling threats
top_creatures.change: Floaters get a glow pass and a different idle

top_creatures.label: Pack humanoid family
top_creatures.why: Ten NPC ids share one model (goblin, kobold and orc style)
top_creatures.change: Our own colours and armour trims

top_creatures.label: Quadruped family
top_creatures.why: Nine ids share one fast-body model

top_creatures.label: Undead family

top_creatures.label: Large slow family

classes: Warrior: STA+25 or STR+7 and STA+18 (docs/specs/2026-06-26-pregame-screens-design.md:452-459)
Beastlord: even +5 across STA, AGI, DEX and WIS
Berserker: STR+25, or STR+10 and STA+15
weapon_families: None in the box. Held weapons are per-item models drawn at a hand bone (crates/eqoxide-renderer/src/gpu.rs:49); swing animation verified on one race (README.md:41)
gear_tiers: Nine equipment slots, each with a material id (u32) and an RGB tint (docs/equipment-textures-findings.md:100-101)
Tint is an RGB multiplier on the texture (docs/equipment-textures-findings.md:82)
WearChange updates material and tint per slot at runtime (docs/equipment-textures-findings.md:105; docs/equipment_texture_plan.md:212-233)
Region-variant armour pieces (from AU016; docs/equipment-textures-findings.md material name section, not re-read)
Hair tint table, 24 entries, gated to a race and gender subset (crates/eqoxide-renderer/src/head.rs:16-19, :31-33)
Helms, hair and head armour not built (README.md:46)
Material tiers (cloth to plate) and mythic metals: not in the client; item database is server-side and not in the box
zones: Moat with ladders: wall about 10 units, five authored ladder objects around the ring (crates/eqoxide-zone-geometry/src/climb.rs:6-9)
Water volumes: sparse water-span grid instead of a full 3D voxel grid; Slice 1 additive only (crates/eqoxide-zone-geometry/src/water_grid.rs:1-9)
Multi-level dungeons: floor selection survives a stale start z (docs/collision-system.md:91; docs/autonomous-play.md:213)
Outdoor vertical offset: some outdoor zones render terrain with a Z offset (README rendering table; known defect)

looks.label: Additive glow surfaces
looks.technique: A material flagged eqAdditive blends by pure addition, so black texels vanish; for torches, forges and magic

looks.label: Animated material
looks.technique: A millisecond interval and a frame list from extras.eqAnim, for flicker and water

looks.label: Foliage cutout with corner key
looks.technique: Alpha test at 128 of 255, plus a corner-colour key-out fallback at bake time

looks.label: Precipitation field
looks.technique: Rain as thin streaks, snow as small camera-facing drifting flakes; camera-centred wrap; cap 4000 at full intensity, floor 1200 for any active weather

looks.label: Held weapon at hand bone
looks.technique: Held item is a separate model cached per item and drawn at a hand bone, not baked into the body

looks.label: Per-clip grounding (from AU016, not re-read)
looks.technique: Skinned humanoid scaled to a target height and re-grounded from the current clip bounds

looks.label: Gated hair tint
looks.technique: 24-entry tint table applied only to a race and gender subset that the native client tints

originals.name: Moat-Ladder Keep (zone)
originals.idea: A moat whose wall needs an authored climb object to cross
originals.keep: Authored climb anchors; a wall too high to step
originals.change: Anchors are breakable grapples in zone data

originals.name: Lantern Hall (look)
originals.idea: Torches and braziers on an additive glow pass with a short frame list
originals.change: Cooler ember ramp and a three-frame cycle

originals.name: Squall Field (weather)
originals.idea: A camera-centred precipitation field with a particle cap and a floor
originals.keep: Camera wrap; rain and snow kinds
originals.change: Add a sleet band; caps tuned to our frame budget

originals.name: Best-Fit Roster (creature families)
originals.idea: Every unknown NPC id maps to a family so nothing renders blank
originals.change: Our six families and a visible placeholder tag; no NPC names carried

originals.name: Class Spine (classes)
originals.idea: One primary stat bonus (+20 or +25 in the spec) and an optional secondary (+5) per class
originals.change: Our four archetypes (Duelist, Guard, Caster, Beastcaller) with our own numbers

originals.name: Relic Hilt (weapon look)
originals.idea: A held weapon as its own model at the hand bone, with a glowing hilt at top tier only
originals.keep: Separate held model at the bone
originals.change: Our hilt designs; glow reserved for the top tier

originals.name: Tint-Slot Armour (gear look)
originals.idea: Nine slots, each with a material and an RGB tint, updated live on equip
originals.change: Our metal ramps (bronze, gold-plate) and region pieces with our silhouettes
